summary: Enhance your business efficiency with our Data Analytics Course. Learn to optimize processes and drive growth through effective data-driven strategies.
lede: Business process optimization through data analytics helps professionals examine process data, operational metrics, and performance patterns to uncover waste, variation, bottlenecks, and root causes. You will map current and future-state processes, assess data quality, define useful KPIs, and turn findings into measurable improvement actions. The course also introduces automation-supported workflow analysis and AI-assisted dashboard interpretation at an operational level, helping you work effectively with incomplete data, legacy spreadsheets, and scattered reporting. You will learn to build dashboard-ready metrics and present a defensible case for change that managers and executives can review and act on.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to analyse process performance, improve workflows, and present data-backed recommendations to operations and leadership teams.
audience: Continuous improvement specialists using Lean Six Sigma
prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with business operations, process steps, and basic spreadsheet analysis. Prior exposure to KPI reporting, dashboard reading, or operational data is helpful, but coding is not required. You should bring a laptop and be prepared to work with Excel or Power BI for practical exercises, depending on your organization’s preferred workflow and the datasets provided during training.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
